feeds.title: Mountain Running & Living
feeds.description: Sarah's Running blog features personal essays with practical advice about trail running, mountain life, and midlife grit. For eight years, she specialized in coaching scores of runners in mountain/ultra/trail running and she wrote a book (The Trail Runner's Companion) that has the information and inspiration one needs to effectively self-train.

feeds.title: Fort Collins Running Club Blog
feeds.description: Since 1971, the mission of the Fort Collins Running Club has been to promote running in Fort Collins, Colorado, and its surrounding communities by providing an enjoyable and positive running atmosphere. It provides competitive and participatory events for runners of all abilities and interests. Find the latest club news on the blog.

feeds.title: Team RunRun Blog
feeds.description: Team RunRun is a family - literally and figuratively. It is designed for runners by runners. Its blog posts include race reports, intel for your next race, and training tips for racing, nutrition, and training.

feeds.title: Pikes Peak Marathon Blog
feeds.description: The Pikes Peak Marathon, founded in 1956, is the oldest continually held marathon in the United States, taking runners from Manitou Springs, Colorado, to the summit of Pikes Peak at 14,115 feet, and back down for a total of 26.2 grueling mountain miles. Find all the information on the marathon on its blog.

feeds.title: Colorado Runner
feeds.description: Colorado Runner is your source for running news, events, and results in Colorado. The mission of Colorado Runner is to be the go-to source for running and multi-sport information in the Rocky Mountain Region. They offer Colorado Race Results, a Colorado Running Calendar, and Colorado Running News.

feeds.title: Janet Runyan Blog
feeds.description: Janet Runyan is a nationally-ranked distance runner whose goals have served as motivation and inspiration for improving her whole life through athletic pursuits. She has worked as a running coach with hundreds of elite and recreational runners over the past 25 years in the Boulder and Greater Denver areas to improve their running form with profound results.

feeds.title: Colorado Marathon Blog
feeds.description: This is the official website for one of the most stunning races in the country, the Colorado Marathon. Their goal is to eliminate paper waste through cupless racing to keep the Poudre River and their course clean. Their thoughtful strategy from registration to race day ensures a tailored and enjoyable experience for all runners, and your support will be instrumental in making that happen.

feeds.title: Shut Up + Run
feeds.description: Beth Risdon loves to run. She discovered it 11 years ago. Like she does most things, she went from zero to 26.2 miles. No half marathons for her, no running cross country in high school. She just set her mind to it, trained, and crossed the finish line. She also loves to write. She believes in holding nothing back. She believes in telling the truth. She believes in being real.

feeds.title: Strength Running Blog
feeds.description: Started in 2010, Strength Running helps runners reach all of their wildest ambitions. They give runners the tools, mindset, and training to achieve their loftiest dreams - like qualifying for Boston, running an ultramarathon, or whatever you are most interested in doing as a runner. They will help you understand running from both a physiologic and practical standpoint.
